This script holds every diagnosis, procedure and billing code list the analysis uses. By the maintainer's decision, the lists come from the 2025-03-25 reconstruction of the original analysis rather than from Supplementary Table 1 of the paper [@fiorica2025]. The two are identical except for diabetes and the HCPCS drug codes (below).

::: {.Rcode title="Source code"}
The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/code_lists.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Fiorica-cryptoccoccus-analysis/blob/main/R/code_lists.R)

It is sourced by [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Fiorica-cryptoccoccus-analysis/blob/main/R/setup.R).
:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
#| cache: false
knitr::read_chunk("../R/code_lists.R")
```

## One table of codes

All lists are in one table, `code_lists`, with one row per code. Each row has five fields:

- the **concept** (for example `cryptococcosis` or `lumbar_puncture`);
- the **code type**: diagnosis, procedure or HCPCS;
- the **code system**;
- the **code**, without its decimal point;
- whether the code matches **exactly** or as a **prefix**;
- its **source**: the reconstruction, or the supplement for the HCPCS codes.

Every code matches exactly. The supplement lists the diabetes categories as open prefixes (`E11*`). The reconstruction instead lists each stem alone or followed by one or two digits, so `E1122` is included but the longer `E11649` is not; the code follows the reconstruction. The cyclosporine and tacrolimus HCPCS codes appear only in the supplement, and are kept, marked as such, until [#2](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Fiorica-cryptoccoccus-analysis/issues/2) settles how immunosuppression is measured. The reconstruction also has an IRIS list and a principal-diagnosis cryptococcosis list, which the paper's analyses do not use and which are left out. That includes the three-character `B45` in the cryptococcosis list, which therefore matches only a code recorded as `B45` itself.

```{r}
#| label: code-lists-diabetes-stems
#| eval: false
```

The code system is inferred from each code's form: ICD-10-PCS codes have seven characters, and ICD-10-CM codes start with a letter. It should be checked against the official code sets.

**Decision pending:** the procedure lists are reproduced as published, but the paper's text names CPT codes, and no ventriculoperitoneal shunt list is given ([#5](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Fiorica-cryptoccoccus-analysis/issues/5)).
